sangsad.name: Jatiyo Sangsad Bhaban (National Parliament House)
sangsad.price_text: Free, but entry needs advance permission
sangsad.hours: Visitor access by prior arrangement only; check on the day
sangsad.tip: Louis Kahn's concrete masterpiece. View it from the outside freely; inside visits need written permission.

lalbagh.name: Lalbagh Fort
lalbagh.price_text: ≈ BDT 200 for foreign visitors; check on the day
lalbagh.hours: Tue–Sat roughly 10:00–17:00 · closed Sunday and Monday
lalbagh.tip: Come early to beat the heat. The mosque and tomb inside are the highlights.

ahsan.name: Ahsan Manzil (Pink Palace)
ahsan.price_text: ≈ BDT 200 for foreign visitors; check on the day
ahsan.tip: Pair it with a Buriganga river walk right outside. The upper floors have the best views.

shaheed.name: Shaheed Minar
shaheed.tip: A moving memorial to the language movement. Visit quietly and avoid crowds on 21 February.

dhakeshwari.name: Dhakeshwari Temple
dhakeshwari.tip: Remove shoes before entering. Ask before photographing worshippers.

armenian.name: Armenian Church of the Holy Resurrection
armenian.hours: Often closed; check on the day
armenian.tip: A quiet, fading piece of old Dhaka history. Call ahead or ask your guide to arrange a look inside.

newmarket.name: Dhaka New Market
newmarket.price_text: Free to enter · pay per item
newmarket.hours: Roughly 10:00–20:00 · closed some days, check on the day
newmarket.tip: Haggle politely and keep small notes. The surrounding food stalls are as good as the shopping.

fantasy.name: Fantasy Kingdom
fantasy.price_text: Entry plus ride tickets; check on the day
fantasy.tip: A long way north of the centre. Go early and plan a full half-day with kids.

paturi.name: Ilish Macher Paturi (mustard hilsa in banana leaf)
paturi.price_text: ≈ BDT 400–900 per dish depending on restaurant
paturi.hours: Lunch and dinner at most Bengali restaurants
paturi.tip: Best in monsoon season. Try it at an Old Dhaka restaurant for the classic version.

martyrs.name: National Martyrs' Memorial (Jatiyo Smriti Soudho)
martyrs.tip: Outside the city near Savar. Combine it with a Panam City day trip.

panam.name: Panam City
panam.price_text: Small entry fee; check on the day
panam.hours: Daylight hours; check on the day
panam.tip: A ruined 16th-century merchant town near Sonargaon. Go with a guide and start early.

shishu.name: Shishu Park
shishu.price_text: Small entry fee plus ride tickets; check on the day
shishu.tip: A simple amusement park for young children. Skip it if you are short on time.

buriganga.name: Buriganga river boat ride
buriganga.tip: Agree the price and duration before boarding. A small wooden boat is calmer than the big ferries.

olddhakawalk.name: Old Dhaka heritage walk
olddhakawalk.price_text: ≈ BDT 1,500–4,000 per person with a guide
olddhakawalk.tip: A guided walk links the fort, temples and lanes you would miss alone. Wear closed shoes.

kawran.name: Kawran Bazar food market
kawran.price_text: Free to enter · pay per item
kawran.tip: Go early for the freshest produce and street snacks. Keep valuables close in the crowds.

gulshanlake.name: Gulshan Lake walk
gulshanlake.hours: Daylight hours; lit paths in the evening
gulshanlake.tip: A calm loop past embassies and cafés. Good for a sunset stroll away from the traffic.

bananiwalk.name: Banani neighbourhood walk and cafés
bananiwalk.price_text: Free to walk · cafés pay per item
bananiwalk.tip: A relaxed area for coffee, bakeries and people-watching. Good for a slow afternoon.

rickshaw.name: Cycle-rickshaw ride through Old Dhaka
rickshaw.price_text: ≈ BDT 100–300 per short ride, agree first
rickshaw.tip: The classic Dhaka experience. Fix the fare before you start and hold on.

bashundhara.name: Bashundhara City shopping mall
bashundhara.price_text: Free to enter · pay per item
bashundhara.tip: A huge mall with a food court. Good for a hot or rainy afternoon indoors.

biriyani.name: Old Dhaka biriyani dinner
biriyani.hours: Lunch and dinner; busy in the evening
biriyani.tip: Try a well-known Old Dhaka biriyani house. Go hungry and expect a queue.

starmosque.name: Star Mosque (Tara Masjid)
starmosque.hours: Outside prayer times; check on the day
starmosque.tip: Small but beautiful blue-star tilework. Dress modestly and remove shoes.
